value.rationale: Natural gap: the existing Herglotz critical-frame theorem does not quantify optimal frame bounds. The theorem yields exact sharp stability for every positive discrete or continuous pole ensemble, with a global, equality-rigid obstruction to improving conditioning by mixing. The nonnegative quadratic deficit gives structural sensitivity to dispersion of pole heights, rather than a routine single-parameter substitution. The result has a concrete role in robust critical Gabor analysis but claims no result beyond this family.
